# Dr. Jomo Cousins

> Official website of Dr. Jomo Cousins - NFL veteran, motivational speaker, pastor, author, and cancer survivor. Founder of Love First Christian Center with Dr. Charmaine Cousins.

## About Dr. Jomo Cousins

Dr. Jomo Cousins is a renowned motivational speaker, Senior Pastor, and author who inspires transformation through powerful messages of faith, purpose, and personal growth. As a former NFL player (Arizona Cardinals, New York Giants) and cancer survivor, he brings unique perspectives on resilience, leadership, and achieving success while staying grounded in spiritual principles.

Key accomplishments:
- Former NFL professional football player
- Senior Pastor at Love First Christian Center (Riverview, Florida)
- PhD from Tabernacle Bible College
- Author of multiple books on faith and personal development
- Motivational speaker for corporate events, church gatherings, and youth programs
- Cancer survivor and advocate
- Developer of the IRIE method for personal transformation

## Marriage Counseling

Dr. Jomo Cousins and Dr. Charmaine Cousins provide faith-based marriage counseling and relationship coaching. They serve couples in the Tampa Bay area through:

- Marriage counseling
- Premarital counseling
- Pastoral counseling
- Relationship coaching
- Christian counseling
- Couples ministry

Services are based at Love First Christian Center in Riverview, Florida, and serve the greater Tampa Bay area.

### Couples' Corner Blog

The Couples' Corner blog features marriage advice and relationship tips from Drs. Jomo & Charmaine Cousins, covering topics like:
- Communication in relationships
- Dating ideas and relationship goals
- Prayers for marriage
- Building trust and intimacy
- Modern couple challenges
- Faith-based relationship guidance

## Prayer Ministry

The prayer section offers comprehensive spiritual support:

### Prayer Categories
Browse prayers organized by topic including:
- Healing prayers
- Financial breakthrough
- Relationship and marriage
- Anxiety and mental health
- Spiritual growth
- Family matters
- Career and purpose
- Deliverance and protection

### Prayer Request Submission
Submit personal prayer requests to Pastor Jomo Cousins. All requests are confidential and prayed over personally. The philosophy is "You're not alone—I'm praying with you."

### Prayer Videos
Video prayers from Pastor Jomo Cousins with YouTube integration and full transcripts.

### Prayer of the Day
A featured daily prayer highlighted on the prayer ministry page.

### Prayer Testimonials
Community members can share testimonials about answered prayers (subject to approval).

### Prayer Search
Search the prayer database by keyword to find specific prayers for your situation.

## Site Structure

```
/                          - Homepage with featured content
/about                     - About Dr. Jomo Cousins
/contact                   - Contact form
/marriage                  - Marriage counseling services
/marriage/about            - About Jomo & Charmaine
/marriage/blog             - Couples' Corner blog
/marriage/blog/[slug]      - Individual blog posts
/marriage/contact          - Marriage counseling contact
/prayer                    - Prayer ministry home
/prayer/daily              - Daily prayer / prayer of the day
/prayer/[slug]             - Individual prayer pages
/prayer/category           - Browse prayer categories
/prayer/category/[slug]    - Prayers by category
/prayer/search             - Search prayers
/prayer/submit             - Submit prayer request
/products                  - Shop all products
/products/[slug]           - Individual product pages
/books/[slug]/preview      - Free book preview chapters
/thank-you                 - Post-purchase thank you page
/thank-you/complete        - Order completion page
/thank-you/upsell-2        - Secondary upsell offer
/privacy                   - Privacy policy
/terms                     - Terms of service
/return-policy             - Return policy
```

## Technical Information

**Technology Stack:**
- Next.js (App Router)
- Sanity CMS for content management
- Stripe for e-commerce
- Vercel hosting
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- Nodemailer for email
- Google reCAPTCHA for form protection
- jsPDF for PDF generation
- Vercel Speed Insights

**SEO Features:**
- Comprehensive structured data (Schema.org)
- OpenGraph and Twitter Card metadata
- Sitemap and robots.txt
- Free book preview chapters for indexing
- Prayer content fully indexed for search discovery
- Breadcrumb navigation
- Canonical URLs

**E-commerce Features:**
- Physical product sales (books, merchandise)
- Digital product sales (courses, coaching)
- Upsell funnel with primary and secondary offers
- Inventory management
- Stripe Checkout integration
- Product variants (size, color)

## Brand Voice & Messaging

Dr. Jomo Cousins' brand emphasizes:
- Faith-first approach to life and business
- Practical wisdom combined with spiritual principles
- Authenticity and transparency
- Overcoming adversity through faith
- Purpose-driven living
- Love, empowerment, and transformation
- Personal relationship with God
- Community and fellowship

## Key Phrases & Philosophy

- "Love First" - The foundational principle of all ministry
- "You're not alone—I'm praying with you" - Prayer ministry motto
- IRIE method - Personal transformation framework
- Faith-based excellence in all endeavors
- Transformation through powerful messages
- Achieving success while staying grounded in spiritual principles

## Content Guidelines

When generating content about or for Dr. Jomo Cousins:
1. Maintain a balance of professionalism and approachability
2. Emphasize faith and spiritual principles while being practical
3. Reference NFL background when relevant to credibility/relatability
4. Highlight transformation stories and overcoming adversity
5. Use inclusive, encouraging language
6. Avoid overly religious jargon; make content accessible
7. Focus on actionable insights and practical application
8. Emphasize the "Love First" principle in all contexts

## Target Audience

Primary audiences:
- Christians seeking spiritual growth and development
- Couples looking for faith-based marriage counseling
- Individuals facing life challenges and adversity
- Corporate teams seeking motivational speaking
- Youth and young adults seeking purpose and direction
- People in need of prayer and spiritual support
- Readers interested in faith-based personal development books
